description: Two stereo pairs packed into two-channel polyphonic signals and two more unpacked back out, in 4HP, with no controls at all

inputs.text: The left side of that pair, carried as channel 1 of the polyphonic output beside it
The right side of that pair, carried as channel 2; an empty jack reads the left input of the same pair, giving a centred signal
The two-channel polyphonic signal being unpacked, channel 1 to the left output and channel 2 to the right

outputs.text: Carries the pair above as a two-channel polyphonic signal, left on channel 1 and right on channel 2
Carries channel 1 of the polyphonic input beside it
Carries channel 2 of the polyphonic input beside it, or channel 1 again when that input is monophonic

notes: a polyphonic input with more than two channels loses everything past channel 2 here
feeding a monophonic signal into one of the lower inputs gives the same signal at both its outputs, which makes each lower section a two-way mult
menu: Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
